user.title: Connect ioBroker bridge
user.description:
Connects Home Assistant with the ioBroker adapter **homeassistant-bridge** (version 0.5.0 or newer). Your existing MQTT connection is used – no password needed.

Usually Home Assistant finds the bridge by itself. Enter it here only if you changed the base topic in the adapter.

data_description.base_topic: See the ioBroker adapter, tab “Erweitert” → “Basis-Topic”. Default: iobroker-ha/0

confirm.title: ioBroker bridge found
confirm.description:
Found: ioBroker instance **{instance}** (adapter version {version}, topic `{base}`).

After the setup you choose in the integration which Home Assistant devices are sent to ioBroker. The group “Standard” already exists.

error.invalid_topic: Invalid topic – only letters, digits, _ and - separated by /, e.g. iobroker-ha/0
error.no_bridge: No ioBroker bridge answers on this topic. Is the adapter homeassistant-bridge (0.5.0 or newer) running and connected to the same broker?

abort.already_configured: This ioBroker bridge is already set up.
abort.mqtt_not_configured: Please set up the MQTT integration of Home Assistant first.
abort.invalid_discovery_info: The message of the ioBroker bridge was incomplete.

user.title: Add group
user.description: A group defines which Home Assistant devices are sent to ioBroker and how often. In ioBroker they appear below homeassistant-bridge.0.ha.

data_description.name: For sorting. Shown in ioBroker for each object.
data_description.entities: These entities are sent to ioBroker. Not offered: entities that come from ioBroker (that would create a loop) and entities of other groups.
data_description.areas: All visible entities of these areas – including ones added later. Leave empty if you only want single entities.
data_description.mode: Default: immediately. “At most every …” saves load for values that change all the time (e.g. power).
data_description.interval: Only for “at most every …” and “immediately + regularly”. Default: 60 s.
data_description.control: Default: on. ioBroker can then switch these devices (e.g. light on, cover up). Off = ioBroker only shows the values.

reconfigure.title: Edit group
reconfigure.description: Changes apply right after saving. Removed entities are marked as “no longer transferred” in ioBroker.
